seo.title: About Logic Controls | Automation Engineers in Egypt
seo.description: Logic Controls is an industrial automation company in 6th of October City, Egypt. Our engineers bring 4+ years of experience and 50+ projects.

lead: Industrial automation engineers in 6th of October City, Giza. We design, program and commission control systems for factories in Egypt.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Logic Controls is a young company with an experienced engineering team: more than four years of industrial automation work and more than 50 delivered projects.

That work covers food, beverage and dairy machines, pharmaceutical coating, cosmetics filling, labeling and bottle printing, concrete batching, hotel laundry machines and test equipment, on Siemens, Schneider Electric, Delta, LS Electric and Wecon platforms. Our engineers have also worked on SCADA for drainage stations and a feed mill, metal-sheet cut-to-length and grinding machines, and decal-paper printing machines.
We built Logic Controls to give factories in Egypt one engineering team for the whole control system: design, panel, programming, commissioning and support.

founder.title: The engineer behind Logic Controls
founder.name: Mohammed Tarek Aboalsafa
bio: Mohammed Tarek Aboalsafa is an industrial automation engineer with more than four years of experience designing, programming, commissioning and maintaining PLC, HMI and SCADA systems for food and beverage, pharmaceutical and other industries. He holds a B.Sc. in Electrical Power and Machines from Helwan University (2020).

Before Logic Controls, he worked as an automation engineer at a multinational pharmaceutical plant in Cairo, in a GMP environment; in R&D at an Egyptian manufacturer of engineering training equipment; and at a machine-automation company.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To deliver control systems that Egyptian factories can run, maintain and extend: reliable, documented and built on platforms with local support.

items.title: Honest engineering
items.text: We say what we can do and quote exactly what we will deliver. If a retrofit is not worth it, we tell you.

items.title: Documented work
items.text: Drawings, I/O lists and operating notes for every system, so your team does not depend on anyone's memory.

items.title: Safety first
items.text: Interlocks, emergency stops and tests before production. We do not skip safety to save time.

items.title: Close to the plant
items.text: Engineers based in Egypt who come to your floor and speak your operators' language.

why.title: Why choose us
items: One team from electrical design to start-up and support
Five PLC and HMI platforms, chosen for your needs rather than our habits
Machine automation and process control experience in the same team
HMI screens in Arabic, English or both
Every I/O point, interlock and alarm tested before production
Written scope and clear limits before work starts

location.title: Where we are
location.text: Our base is in 6th of October City, Giza, in Greater Cairo. We work on site across Egypt's industrial zones.
location.note: Meetings are usually held at your plant. Contact us to arrange a visit.

cta.text: Send a description and photos, or message an engineer on WhatsApp.
